islandCaptureProvenance.method: Native CUA screenshots in the existing Launch demo profile. Actual live NASA webpages; native product DOM, geometry, icons and pixels unchanged. Lossless center-crop exports only. The separate sample window was closed after capture.
islandCaptureProvenance.verification: Strict deep codesign passed outside sandbox. Installed index.html, renderer.js, styles.css, overlay.html and overlay.js match the exact v1.27.0 release-tag bytes. GitHub confirms v1.27.0 was published at 2026-10-04T03:14:49Z.
sample_tabs: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope - NASA Science
Adopt a Pixel Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope - NASA Science
islandCaptureProvenance.presentation: The NASA homepage is scrolled to the Adopt a Pixel section. Center crops feature its dark Roman telescope imagery, leaving the page headline outside the crop. Website frame shows the top 760px on desktop and 850px on narrow screens. CSS clipping/fading between native stills is website choreography, not recorded app motion. Mac window controls fall outside the center crop. The resting backdrop was reframed slightly after the overlay captures; only the overlay panels are revealed from the tabs and command stills.
